explanation: Gut strings were made mostly from sheep intestines, sometimes from goats or cattle. Nobody is sure how the word arose, but there is no evidence that cats were used.

claims.text: Catgut was not made from cats' intestines.
Catgut strings were made mainly from sheep intestines, and sometimes from those of goats or cattle.
The origin of the word catgut is uncertain.
There is no evidence that cat intestines were used to make catgut.
